subject: add: README.md
title: First commit
text: A FastAPI backend and a Next.js front end that ask a model for a chart.

subject: feat(finetune): generate execution-verified code targets with best-of-k
title: Training data
text: Claude writes the code answers; the app's own sandbox keeps only the ones that render.

subject: feat(finetune): LoRA adapter trained and scored — render rate 7.7% to 91.3%
title: lora-v1
text: The first adapter, trained on a rented A100 and scored on the frozen test set.

subject: feat(dashboard): plan dashboards with the analyst and planner, checked by code
title: Dashboards planned by the model
text: An analyst and a planner plan whole dashboards; code checks every column against the real tables.

subject: data(finetune): lora-v2 on the frozen 300 - 97.3% render, 87.0% right shape
title: lora-v2
text: Retrained with planning examples added; it plans and draws better than lora-v1.

subject: feat(chartist): no hardcoded charts; failed code goes back to the model
title: No hardcoded charts
text: Code that fails goes back to the model to fix; nothing else ever draws a chart.

subject: feat(chartist): the drawing check sends back bars that repeat a category
title: The drawing check
text: Bars that stack raw rows go back to the model to be aggregated.
